notes.title: Who I Am and What I Plan to Do
notes.notes:
Dear owners of Star King Eight Legends, thank you very much for starting this game!

I am currently a PhD in mathematics in China, and programming is my hobby. I really enjoy expressing and presenting myself by making programs. I like to use C++ for programming, because this language is relatively low-level, I think with it I can incorporate my style into every detail of the game.

I know the theme of this game is very weird, but I just want to make something like this haha. My goal is to make a game that first simulates a rich world, and then using this world we can generate little stories from an individual's point of view. [b] I'm still working on this game, and I promise it will receive a lot of content updates. [/b]

My homepage of Bilibili (Chinese Youtube) is here ([url=https://space.bilibili.com/381596633?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0]click here to visit[/url]), if you are interested, you can follow this account or get the game latest progress.
